turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Sit down, Hale. I have twenty minutes. Owen found out his essay was a zero from his phone, in the middle of your class. Start there.
Before we go on, I'm recording this meeting.
Record it. Then tell me why nobody called me before my son's mark went into the gradebook.
And if you so much as mention legal action, I'm filing a harassment complaint through the union.
Then file it. I haven't mentioned legal action, Hale. I asked who decided, and before whom, when my son's zero was entered without a phone call to me.
I have been choosing them carefully for twenty years. Who entered the zero, and when?
